text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Maybe I should
pay a little mind to it after all?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Earlier, Biko-chan told me...
"Your skin's breaking out like a monster's!?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm not too bothered by it, but if you say so, Biko-chan...
I guess I should clean it... maybe~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono seemed troubled,
unable to stop being strangely self-conscious about her rough skin...
